source_metadata.title: Montelukast in hospitalized patients diagnosed with COVID-19

extraction_metadata.scope_note: Primary study methods, baseline imbalances, primary outcome, regression analyses, prespecified sensitivity analyses, limitations, disclosures, funding, and data availability were extracted. Background claims from cited literature and bibliography entries were not atomized.

atoms.canonical_statement: The study evaluated whether montelukast treatment was associated with less clinical deterioration from hospital Day 1 to Day 3 among patients hospitalized with confirmed COVID-19.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The objective of this study was to determine if montelukast treatment would reduce the rate of clinical deterioration.

population.label: Hospitalized adults with confirmed COVID-19 analyzed in the retrospective cohort

exposures.details: Initiated on hospital Day 1 for COVID-19 supplemental care.
Hospitalized comparator patients who did not receive montelukast.

outcome.definition: Any increase in COVID-19 Ordinal Scale from Day 1 to Day 3

atoms.canonical_statement: Investigators screened 256 hospitalized patients for length of stay and montelukast exposure.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Two hundred and fifty-six patients were screened for the following factors: hospitalization length of stay and montelukast.

population.label: Screened hospitalized COVID-19 cohort

atoms.canonical_statement: The analyzed cohort included 92 patients: 30 received montelukast and 62 did not.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A total of 92 patients were analyzed, 30 who received montelukast ... and 62 patients who did not receive montelukast.

population.label: Hospitalized adults with confirmed COVID-19 analyzed in the retrospective cohort

atoms.canonical_statement: Patients were hospitalized for at least three days and were included in ordinal-scale analyses only if their assessment score was at least 3, indicating hospitalization.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: patients were included only if found to have an Ordinal Scale score of 3 or higher

population.label: Study eligibility
inclusion_criteria: Hospitalized for at least three days
COVID-19 Ordinal Scale score at least 3 at assessment

atoms.canonical_statement: Control patients were selected consecutively from confirmed COVID-19 patients who survived to at least the fourth hospital day.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The control group ... was selected consecutively ... who survived to at least the fourth day of admission.

population.label: Control-group selection
inclusion_criteria: Survived to at least hospital Day 4

atoms.canonical_statement: Montelukast-treated patients began montelukast 10 mg orally once daily on hospital Day 1; none had been receiving montelukast before admission.
